summary: Describes how to provide authentication and confidentiality to OSPFv3 by using the IPv6 Authentication Header and Encapsulating Security Payload extension headers. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Routers tell each other where roads lead. This explains how to put a lock and a signature on those messages so a fake router cannot trick the real ones.

questions: how to secure ospfv3 with ipsec
